mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_preferences (user_id, is_completed, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, FALSE, NOW(), NOW())

INSERT INTO customer_preferences (user_id, trading_experience, risk_tolerance, trading_style, investment_horizon, preferred_sectors, trading_frequency, is_completed, created_at, updated_at) SELECT #{userId}, #{tradingExperience}, #{riskTolerance}, #{tradingStyle}, #{investmentHorizon}, #{preferredSectors}, #{tradingFrequency}, TRUE, NOW(), NOW() WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM customer_preferences p WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_preferences SET trading_experience = #{tradingExperience}, risk_tolerance = #{riskTolerance}, trading_style = #{tradingStyle}, investment_horizon = #{investmentHorizon}, preferred_sectors = #{preferredSectors}, trading_frequency = #{tradingFrequency}, is_completed = TRUE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
